name: hud_ui_triplet_panel_scalar_deleting_destructor
description: HudUiTripletPanel::ScalarDeletingDestructor runs DestructorCore, conditionally deletes the panel when flag bit 0 is set, and returns self.

functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40f2b0 validates the call to HudUiTripletPanel::DestructorCore, flag bit 0 test on the scalar-deleting destructor argument, conditional call to operator delete(self), self return in eax, and callee stack cleanup for the flag argument.
0x40d610 HudUiTripletPanel::DestructorCore is functionally equivalent under target hud_ui_triplet_panel_destructor_core; operator delete is an accepted import/jump/dispatch provider boundary.

The native triplet-panel destructor smoke verifies the non-deleting scalar path returns self and destroys embedded items, and the heap-allocated deleting path returns the original pointer while safely taking the operator-delete branch.
